An '''Ag'Tra''' was the head of one of the twenty-nine noble families that served the [[En'Tra]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coyn]]. Each Ag'Tra ruled over a [[Sarrh'Tais]], and had fifty-eight elite warriors known as [[Kroyn]] serving under them.<ref name="PoG3" />
